comps.label: C2

comps.label: C3

comps.label: C4

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Mainly gas distribution and pipelines with sizable propane and marketing; electric is minor, so only a partial match.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Regulated water and wastewater utility in Arizona; different service than electric, gas and steam.

comps.label: C7

comps.label: C8

comps.label: C9

comps.label: C10
